## Context / immutable basis
Exactly 102 bloated prose blocks are confirmed in 14 paths under tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/. Condense redundant or historical text while retaining current non-obvious contracts.

Inventory and before-citations are pinned to origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84. All impacted blobs match the clean audit worktree at 10533b1e3f651a60e8cea5691318c108ff1f3396. Implement from current origin/main; keep d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84 as the immutable before side. The leaf is one commit (HEAD^..HEAD).

## Boundary and guards
Edit only the anchored ordinary comments/docstrings below and adjacent blank lines. Currentize RED, pre-fix, “Today”, and implementation-scaffolding prose. Executable statements, assertions, runtime strings, directives, and unlisted prose stay unchanged.

Parse base/final files with ast.parse(source, type_comments=True); strip only leading Expr(Constant(str)) nodes from Module/ClassDef/FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef bodies; normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno; require exact ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False) equality. Tokenizer comparison preserves exact directive text/attachment; runtime strings remain AST-identical.

## Scope — 102 editable blocks
- test_at_most_one_invariant.py (8) — module, _make_subprocess_result, test_c_legacy_dedup_key_still_recognized, _load_reconcile, test_reconcile_once_invokes_invariant_after_fetch, test_end_to_end_second_write_produces_one_alert_one_bug; comments beginning “Canonical 16-hex format required” and “Exactly one at-most-one invariant”. Decorative Test (a)–(f) banners are excluded.
- test_e2e_dedup_pass.py (1) — test_pre_existing_rebar_id_produces_zero_creates. Preserve bound-vs-unbound end-to-end dedup behavior.
- test_invariants.py (4) — module, _ok_cli_result, test_valid_cli_output_extracts_id_and_patches_alert, and comment beginning “Regression: ticket-ID extraction”. Decorative scenario banners are excluded.
- test_main_entry.py (4) — module and test_{run_pass_returns_0_when_all_steps_absent,run_pass_returns_75_on_reschedule_error,main_returns_0_when_reconcile_succeeds}. Preserve exit-code and delegation contracts.
- test_main_truthful_tally.py (3) — module and test_{run_pass_prints_applied_count_when_writes_succeed,run_pass_does_not_say_converged_when_applied_nonzero}. Replace RED/history wording with the implemented truthful tally.
- test_mode_cap_enforcement.py (18) — module, applier_mod, _make_mutations, test_{live_uncapped,phase_gate_still_blocks,spot_check_sampling_is_deterministic_across_runs,reconcile_once_legacy_caller_omits_mode_kwarg,manifest_renderer_handles_typed_and_legacy_dict_shapes}; comments beginning “Reuse the exact module”, “Deferred list”, “LIVE must NOT leave”, “Patch the applier module”, “reconcile.py loads via”, “Bug c903”, “check_phase_gate reads”, “The branch under test”, “Bug 85a1”, and “Belt-and-braces runtime guarantee”. Condense abandoned loader/patch narratives to the actual identity and interception seams.
- test_orchestrator_wiring.py (13) — module, _stub_modules; TestOutboundCreate.test_outbound_create_generates_typed_mutation; TestOutboundUpdate.test_outbound_update_generates_typed_mutation_with_changed_fields; TestInboundUpdate.test_inbound_differ_mutations_included_in_apply; TestCapCombined.test_combined_outbound_and_legacy_mutations_passed_to_apply; TestSyncLogger.test_sync_logger_lifecycle; TestBindingStoreSaved.test_binding_store_save_called; test_{read_local_tickets_live_path_strips_ambient_sync_pull,read_local_ticket_full_live_path_strips_ambient_sync_pull}; comments beginning “The applier.apply should”, “_read_local_tickets moved”, and “Only intercept OUR ticket-CLI”.
- test_preview_lifecycle_intents.py (1) — module. Preserve additive versioned outcome/redaction contract.
- test_reconcile_invariant_phase.py (6) — module and test_{invariant_phase_passes_quarantine_set_to_differ,invariant_phase_passes_seed_mutations_to_differ,schema_drift_post_emit_filter_invokes_report,same_pass_follow_on_emitted,real_repair_failure_follow_on_is_surfaced}. Preserve same-pass quarantine/seed/follow-on wiring.
- test_reconcile_once.py (10) — module, _make_acli_module, _make_jql_partitioned_acli; test_{idempotency_two_passes_with_unchanged_remote,excluded_fields_change_does_not_drive_mutations,real_field_change_converges_after_one_pass,dry_run_reconcile_once_writes_nothing,a_key_absent_from_the_current_snapshot_never_reaches_create_issue}; comments beginning “Active query carries” and “Pass 1 healed”. Preserve faithful mutable/JQL stubs, convergence, no-write, and off-window suppression.
- test_reconcile_phases.py (1) — module. Preserve decomposed load/persist phase rationale.
- test_recovery_write_boundary.py (13) — module, mode_mod, _seed_overlap, _drive_load_phase; test_{repair_runs_before_the_first_remote_observation,repair_runs_after_the_under_lock_staleness_gate,merely_constructing_the_store_repairs_nothing,a_reconfirmed_and_cleared_overlap_still_completes_at_the_boundary,an_explicitly_unretired_identity_is_not_repaired_at_the_boundary,a_repair_failure_happens_before_any_remote_call_and_keeps_the_overlap,a_completed_repair_is_reported_to_the_operator,the_repair_is_invoked_from_reconcile_and_not_from_run_differs}; comment beginning “Spy the module PRODUCTION reaches”. Preserve the under-lock, pre-fetch, write-bearing-only boundary and operator reporting.
- test_ticket_plan_shadow.py (19) — module, _drive_run_differs, _deferred_plans; the 14 immutable-basis test_* docstrings of at least 30 words from test_plan_pass_emits_deterministic_sorted_order through test_parity_and_lifecycle_render_perform_zero_io; comments beginning “A shadow plan is attached” and “A LITERAL golden pin”. Preserve immutable planning, dependency/scope decisions, additive manifests, parity, and zero-I/O guarantees.
- test_try_load_step_sys_modules.py (1) — test_try_load_step_registers_module_in_sys_modules. Preserve register-before-exec dataclass resolution.

## Consumers and directives
Pytest collects every module; check_comment_hygiene.py consumes repository prose. No targeted __doc__, inspect.getdoc, or doctest consumer was found.

Preserve exactly 22 directive tokens and attachments: at-most-one (2 union-attr); e2e dedup (union-attr, attr-defined); invariants (1 union-attr); main-entry (union-attr, 2 attr-defined); truthful-tally (union-attr, attr-defined); mode-cap (2 union-attr); orchestrator (1 union-attr); invariant-phase (1 union-attr); reconcile-once (union-attr, method-assign); ticket-plan (one import-bootstrap pragma, one union-attr, three misc ignores, one index ignore).

## Independent receipt
A non-author reviewer posts exactly 102 leaf-linked TSV rows:
path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session

Citations use full SHAs, every after count is lower, and both verdicts are PASS. Missing, duplicate, or extra rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly 102 allowlisted blocks change.
- [ ] Every changed block is shorter.
- [ ] Every changed block states only current rationale or constraints.
- [ ] Every unlisted prose block is byte-identical.
- [ ] `semantic` exits 0.
- [ ] `directives` exits 0.
- [ ] `paths` exits 0 for exactly 14 file-impact paths.
- [ ] `diff` exits 0.
- [ ] `hygiene` exits 0.
- [ ] `focused` exits 0.
- [ ] Untimed `full` exits 0.
- [ ] The non-author TSV has exactly 102 rows.
- [ ] TSV stable IDs are unique.
- [ ] Every row cites the full immutable-base SHA.
- [ ] Every row cites the full final SHA.
- [ ] Every row records `after_words < before_words`.
- [ ] Every row records `semantic-preservation=PASS`.
- [ ] Every row records `bloat-removal=PASS`.
- [ ] Every row names a non-author reviewer session.

## Verification
Run all seven structured commands: semantic, directives, paths, diff, hygiene, focused, full.
